headline: UK regulators report rising AI and agent use across financial services, with limited broad autonomy
summary: The Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority’s 2026 survey of 196 responding firms reports that 86% currently use AI and 80% have AI agents deployed. Among reported agent deployments, decision-support use is common while broad autonomy is rare: 80% of respondents report decision-support agents and 2% report agents with broad autonomy. Third-party systems account for 39% of reported AI systems and 53% of those classed as high materiality. These are self-reported survey results, not a census or measured productivity and safety outcomes.
